log: REV-08: app_defect: The scenario states that an insurance certificate expiring in 0 or 30 days makes GET /api/vendors/{id} flag the vendor with insurance_expiring_soon. In both failing runs the test set up valid data: an insurance_certificate upload with an ISO expiry date that is 0 or 30 days ahead, accepted with 201. The document reached status 'extracted', so the background work finished. The vendor still returned flags: [] with status draft. The 31-day case passes only because it expects no flag, so it does not show that flagging works. The extraction body was truncated in the results, so the extracted expiry value could not be checked. If it turns out the extractor read a null or wrong expiry from this document, the cause would be test data, but the evidence available points to the app not raising the flag.
